svg.title: Pressure stall information
svg.desc: Three tasks' states, the some and full stall shares per 2 s period, and the avg10 exponential averages.
svg.text: 'some' (orange) and 'full' (red) share of each 2 s period
avg10 as the kernel reports it (updated every 2 s) and as isotop reads it
A stall that lasts 10 s at 100 % reads avg10 = 100 (1 - 1/e) = 63 %: the window is a time constant, not a box of 10 s.
isotop samples the file every 2 s on the background thread, so a Cells membrane trembles for several seconds after the stall that caused it.
